item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '100,360p' src/cli.ts
rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"'
tmpdir="'$(mktemp -d)
export TASKBOARD_FILE="$tmpdir/nested/board.json"
run_fail() { label="$1"; shift; out="$tmpdir/$label.out"; err="$tmpdir/$label.err"; if bun run src/cli.ts "$@" >"$out" 2>"$err"; then echo "unexpected success: $label"; return 1; fi; bun -e '"'const s=await Bun.stdin.text(); JSON.parse(s); if(s.trim().split(\"\\n\").length"'!==1) process.exit(2)'"' <\""'$out"; test -s "$err"; }
run_fail no_command
run_fail unknown wat
run_fail add_missing add
run_fail add_empty add --title '"'   '
run_fail add_flag add --title x --wat y
run_fail add_duplicate add --title x --title y
run_fail bad_due add --title x --due 2025-02-29
run_fail list_value list --status
run_fail list_status list --status nope
run_fail list_flag list --wat
run_fail done_bad done 1x
run_fail done_extra done 1 extra
run_fail delete_missing delete 1
mkdir -p \""'$tmpdir/nested"
bun run src/cli.ts add --title A --tags '"', Foo,foo, BAR ,,bar' --due 2024-02-29 >\""'$tmpdir/a.json"
bun run src/cli.ts add --title B >"$tmpdir/b.json"
bun run src/cli.ts delete 1 >"$tmpdir/d.json"
bun run src/cli.ts add --title C >"$tmpdir/c.json"
bun run src/cli.ts list >"$tmpdir/l.json"
bun -e '"'const a=await Bun.file(process.argv[1]).json(); const b=await Bun.file(process.argv[2]).json(); const c=await Bun.file(process.argv[3]).json(); const l=await Bun.file(process.argv[4]).json(); if(a.id"'!==1||JSON.stringify(a.tags)!==JSON.stringify(["foo","bar"])||b.id!==2||c.id!==3||l.map((x:any)=>x.id).join()!=="2,3") process.exit(3)'"' \""'$tmpdir/a.json" "$tmpdir/b.json" "$tmpdir/c.json" "$tmpdir/l.json"
cp "$TASKBOARD_FILE" "$tmpdir/before"
run_fail missing_done done 999
cmp "$TASKBOARD_FILE" "$tmpdir/before"
run_fail stats_flag stats --x
cmp "$TASKBOARD_FILE" "$tmpdir/before"
leftovers=$(find "$tmpdir/nested" -maxdepth 1 -type f ! -name board.json -print)
test -z "$leftovers"
echo ADVERSARIAL_TEST_OK'

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc 'git status --short
git diff --check
git diff -- src/cli.ts README.md
if test -f package.json; then bun test; else echo NO_PACKAGE_TESTS; fi
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
export TASKBOARD_FILE="$tmpdir/board.json"
bun run src/cli.ts add --title Today --due "$(date +%Y-%m-%d)" > "$tmpdir/today.json"
bun run src/cli.ts add --title Old --due 2000-01-01 > "$tmpdir/old.json"
bun run src/cli.ts add --title Future --due 2999-12-31 > "$tmpdir/future.json"
bun run src/cli.ts done 2 > "$tmpdir/done.json"
bun run src/cli.ts list --overdue 2999-01-01 > "$tmpdir/overdue.json"
bun run src/cli.ts stats > "$tmpdir/stats.json"
bun -e '"'const o=await Bun.file(process.argv[1]).json(); const s=await Bun.file(process.argv[2]).json(); if(o.length"'!==1||o[0].title!=="Today"||s.total!==3||s.open!==2||s.done!==1||s.overdue!==0) { console.error({o,s}); process.exit(1) }'"' \""'$tmpdir/overdue.json" "$tmpdir/stats.json"
bun run src/cli.ts list --tag absent > "$tmpdir/empty.json"
bun -e '"'const v=await Bun.file(process.argv[1]).json(); if("'!Array.isArray(v)||v.length!==0) process.exit(1)'"' \""'$tmpdir/empty.json"
cp "$TASKBOARD_FILE" "$tmpdir/snapshot.json"
if bun run src/cli.ts delete 999 > "$tmpdir/error.json" 2> "$tmpdir/error.log"; then exit 1; fi
cmp "$TASKBOARD_FILE" "$tmpdir/snapshot.json"
bun -e '"'const v=await Bun.file(process.argv[1]).json(); if(typeof v"'!=="object"||typeof v.error!=="string") process.exit(1)'"' \""'$tmpdir/error.json"
test -s "$tmpdir/error.log"
echo FINAL_CHECKS_OK'

Готово. Реализовала dependency-free Taskboard CLI в `src/cli.ts` и добавила `README.md` с примерами.

Проверено: сборка Bun, CRUD-команды, фильтры и статистика, стабильные ID, нормализация тегов, валидация дат и аргументов, сохранение между процессами, идемпотентный `done`, защита повреждённой базы и атомарная запись. Все доступные и целевые self-tests прошли.
